See also: ObjectsHelp
You see a strong mana potion.
It weighs 2.90 oz.
This potion can only be consumed by players of level 50 or higher.

  • Aaaah...

Notes

It has a deposit of 5 gp and restores between 115 and 185 Mana Points, around 150 on average.
See also: Money Spent per Mana Point and Capacity Taken per Mana Point

History

  • The price was further increased from 93 gp to 108 gp with the Summer 2024 Update on Jul 01, 2024.
  • Knights gained the ability to consume these potions with the release of the Vocation Adjustments Update on November 23, 2020.
  • The price was increased from 80 gp to 93 gp, additionally the Store prices were also raised with the update on October 29, 2018 shown below.
    • 100x Strong Mana Potions went from 6 Tibia Coins to 7 Tibia Coins.
    • 250x Strong Mana Potions went from 14 Tibia Coins to 17 Tibia Coins.
